summary: Nintendo's Tomodachi Life is a Mii-focused social simulation series route whose 3DS original now depends on physical media or previously purchased digital access after the 3DS eShop shutdown.

entries.title: Tomodachi Life
entries.definitive_edition: Original 3DS cartridge or previously purchased digital copy

emulation.emulator: Citra-derived emulator only for secondary comparison
emulation.notes: Original 3DS hardware is preferred for camera, QR, Mii, and system-feature behavior.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original 3DS hardware with owned cartridge/digital copy

primary.version: Original 3DS physical or previously purchased digital copy
primary.why: Tomodachi Life is a Nintendo 3DS-specific Mii social sim, and Nintendo's 3DS eShop purchasing has ended. The honest archive route is original 3DS hardware with a physical cartridge or a previously purchased/redownloadable digital copy, while the 2026 Switch sequel is a separate game.
primary.how_to_play: Use a 3DS family system with an owned physical cartridge or previously purchased digital copy. Record region, system model/firmware, update data, Mii roster, island/save age, StreetPass/QR/local play state, SpotPass/online shutdown effects, language, and whether Citra-style emulation was used only as comparison.

secondary.why: It is not a replacement for the 3DS game.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record eShop/online shutdown effects and Mii/save provenance.
